title: Engineering Manager, Backend

company.name: Routefold
company.description: Routefold provides freight visibility software for shippers.

ad:
Engineering Manager, Backend (Berlin, hybrid). EUR 110,000–130,000 per year.

You will lead a team of seven backend engineers: hiring, one-to-ones, performance reviews, career development and delivery planning. You will spend most of your time on people leadership and cross-team coordination; hands-on coding is occasional.

Essential: experience managing and growing a team of engineers; backend architecture background.
Preferred: logistics domain.
